helper_start_failed: System helper could not start. Check Shizuku or root compatibility.
system_source_unavailable: System source restricted by this Android build
eco_help: Full collection while in use. Heavy sources pause after the screen has been off for 30 seconds.
full_help: Keeps selected sources active while Android permits. Uses more battery.
bg_settings: Allow unrestricted battery use and manufacturer autostart for background recording.
frame_source_unavailable: Frame data unavailable for this app or Android build
device_dependent: Depends on the device and driver
target_hint: Leave blank to follow the active app
shizuku_help: Start Shizuku with wireless debugging or ADB. After reboot, restart it or use its supported autostart option.
root_help: Only request root if your phone already has it. Denial keeps standard recording available.
trace_help: Bounded local Perfetto recordings. Includes app and process names.
battery_help: Battery temperature is separate from CPU or GPU temperature.
thermal_help: Android's thermal pressure signal; not a CPU temperature measurement.
frames_help: Actual app frame delivery through an authorized system provider. Screen refresh is not app FPS.
cpu_help: System CPU utilization requires an available system source. Headroom is a separate estimate.
memory_help: Android system memory. Cached RAM alone does not prove a shortage.
gpu_help: Read-only clocks and sensors, where the driver exposes them.
